name: FNCE 4305
title: Global Financial Management
description: Focuses on the detailed study of: exchange rate determination, operation of the foreign currency and global capital markets, and hedging both transaction and economic exposure to exchange rate changes.
requirement_description: FNCE 3101 (BUSN majors) or MATH 3650 (Mathematics Actuarial Science Finance majors); open only to Business and Mathematics Actuarial Science Finance majors of junior or higher status.
